    Connecting to helios

    ssh -L 5902:helios.solar.pvt:20000 guest@ovsa.njit.edu

    Daily routine (Checklist)

    Morning (PHASECAL)

    Make sure that calibration runs smoothly

    • Check if data is being written to the IDB files. If not, run rmlock
    • Make sure that all antennas, including 27m, are pointing in correct way. (RA, Dec coordinates for each antenna should match calibration source coordinates e.g. 1229+020)
      • If they are stucked during pcal, do pcycle ant#. Call tracktable pcal_tab.radec five minutes later.

    During the day

    • Check the Schedule either on helios or on EOVSA observing status page: Write down times for all calibrations (PHASECAL, SOLPNTCAL)
    • MAKE SURE the IDB files are being written every time the schedule performs a calibration or returns to the Sun
    • Together with data files list check if Phase tracking state is ON
      • If state is OFF, press STOP and then Start in the Schedule window, or run $scan-start

    Evening

    • Stow everything when observations/calibrations are done
      • e.g. Stow antenna 3 and 11:

      stop ant11

      stow ant11

    • Update and save Tohban notes:
      • Press Ctrl-O in nano and write file under different name1.
    • Start schedule STOP-Clear-Today-GO

    Notes

    • If temperature controller is locked up, run tec$bc ant# in the schedule window
    • If you encountered Error: Could not write stateframe to SQL in the schedule, you need to reset the schedule following EOVSA Troubleshooting guide. If schedule does not close and does not restart showing an error that schedule is already running, run ps -elf | grep "schedule"
    • If schedule is not updated (Time in the Schedule window still can be displayed), then it might have been locked up

    Footnotes:

    1

    Tohban notes are stored in the main home/sched folder
